Terminagotchi — usage:
  terminagotchi.pyz            main window
  terminagotchi.pyz mini       mini-terminal: creature + command line (Termux:Float)
  terminagotchi.pyz bureau     floating desktop companion (PC)
  terminagotchi.pyz veille     lives in the background (notifications)
  terminagotchi.pyz installer  adds the creature to your terminal prompt (+ the « tg » shortcut)
  terminagotchi.pyz desinstaller
  tg lexique                   all commands, by chapter
  tg compte                    online census: compte creer Nickname · compte code · compte lier CODE
  tg sync                      syncs your creature (PC ↔ phone)
  tg site [bestiaire|captures] opens the census website (your profile by default)
  tg collection · tg bestiaire <name>   your critters · a species' card
  tg troupe [name]             your team and their stages · choose the active critter (it grows)
  tg dressage                  the face-off window (opens by itself when a monster appears)
  tg anime <name> [animation]  watch it move: statique, mange, attaque, salut, parle, dort, content,
                               affame, confus, colere, victoire, ko, evolution
  tg langue [fr|en]            the game's language
  tg classe CODE               join your teacher's class (class mode) · tg classe quitter
  tg carte                     the map of the playground, revealed as you discover it
  tg entrainement [discipline]  the training room: timed sessions, badges Bit → Exa
                               (reperer, fichiers, lire, tuyaux, systeme · « stop » to stop)
  tg compte partage on|off     show (or not) your captures in the website gallery
  tg drapeau TG{…}             submits a web CTF flag
  Options: --une-fois (show and quit) · --defi (instant challenge)
